newsitem.title: CANADA: Imperial Oil cuts Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Imperial Oil cuts Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Imperial Oil Ltd said on Friday it lowered the price it would pay for some grades of crude oil by C$10.00/cubic metre or C$1.59/barrel, effective immediately.

The new prices were listed as follows: Edmonton light sweet C$161.00/cubic metre, or C$25.60/barrel Cromer light sour C$152.00/cubic metre, or C$24.01/barrel Bow River at Hardisty C$118.00/cubic metre, or C$18.76/barrel Midale at Cromer C$135.00/cubic metre, or C$21.46/barrel ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
